title: 入境與海關
tips: 澳洲檢疫非常嚴格：食物、藥品、肉乾、水果、種子都要在入境卡上勾 Yes 申報。申報了被沒收沒事，沒申報被查到會罰款。有疑慮就說 "I'd like to declare this."

vocab.on holiday: 度假中（英式/澳式說法，美式是 on vacation）

dialogue.en: Hi there. Passport, please.
Here you go.
What's the purpose of your visit?
We're here on holiday with our kids.
How long are you staying in Australia?
About nine days. We fly home from Sydney on the tenth.
dialogue.zh: 大約九天，我們十號從雪梨回國。

dialogue.en: Where are you staying?
At the QT Hotel on the Gold Coast.
dialogue.zh: 黃金海岸的 QT 飯店。

dialogue.en: Have you got any food or medicine to declare?
dialogue.zh: 你有任何食物或藥品要申報嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, I've got some snacks and medicine for the kids.
dialogue.zh: 有，我有一些零食和小孩的藥。

dialogue.en: Okay, can you open your bag for me, please?
dialogue.zh: 好，可以請你打開包包嗎？

dialogue.en: Sure. It's all in this bag.

keyPhrases.en: I'd like to declare this.
Sorry, could you say that again?
Could you speak a bit more slowly, please?
This is medicine for my child.
Where's the baggage claim?

title: 租車取車
tips: 昆士蘭高速公路很多收費路段（Linkt 電子收費），問清楚租車公司怎麼收、有無手續費。7歲以下小孩法律規定要安全座椅。取車前繞車拍照，有刮痕先請櫃台記錄。

vocab.G'day: 你好（澳洲招牌口語問候）
vocab.licence: 駕照（英式/澳式拼法，美式是 license）
vocab.cover: 保險保障（full cover = 全險）
vocab.excess: 自負額（出事時你要自己付的金額）
vocab.one-way fee: 甲地租乙地還的額外費用
vocab.car park: 停車場（美式是 parking lot）

dialogue.en: G'day! Have you got a booking with us?
dialogue.zh: 你好！你有跟我們預約嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, the booking's under Chen.
Can I see your licence and a credit card, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我看駕照和信用卡嗎？

dialogue.en: Here's my licence and my international driving permit.
dialogue.zh: 這是我的駕照和國際駕照。

dialogue.en: Would you like to add full insurance cover?
What does the full cover include?
It brings your excess down to zero.
dialogue.zh: 它會讓你的自負額降到零。

dialogue.en: Okay, I'll take the full cover, thanks.
We booked two child seats. Are they already in the car?
dialogue.zh: 我們預訂了兩個兒童座椅，已經裝在車上了嗎？

dialogue.en: How do the toll roads work with this car?
dialogue.zh: 這台車的收費道路怎麼算？

dialogue.en: Please bring it back with a full tank.
Does it take petrol or diesel?
dialogue.zh: 這台車加汽油還是柴油？

dialogue.en: We're dropping it off in Sydney. Is that okay?
dialogue.zh: 我們會在雪梨還車，可以嗎？

keyPhrases.en: There's a scratch here. Can you note it down?
keyPhrases.zh: 這裡有刮痕，可以記錄下來嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Is there a one-way fee?
keyPhrases.zh: 甲地租乙地還有額外費用嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Where's the car park?
How do I connect my phone to the car?
Unleaded 91, right?
keyPhrases.zh: 是加 91 無鉛汽油，對嗎？

title: 海鮮市場外帶
tips: 炸魚薯條的「一份」叫 a serve。生蠔常見兩種：Natural（生吃，擠檸檬）和 Kilpatrick（培根加醬焗烤）。澳洲說 tomato sauce 指的就是番茄醬。戶外用餐小心海鷗搶薯條！鵜鶘餵食秀每天 13:30。

vocab.Kilpatrick: 培根加醬汁焗烤的生蠔
vocab.tomato: tomato sauce = 番茄醬（澳洲說法）

dialogue.en: Hi, what can I get you?
Can we get two serves of fish and chips, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我們兩份炸魚薯條嗎？

dialogue.en: Battered or grilled?
Battered, please. And a dozen oysters.
Natural or Kilpatrick?
dialogue.zh: 要原味生的還是焗烤的？

dialogue.en: Natural, please. Do they come with lemon?
Yep. Any sauce with that? Tartare or tomato?
dialogue.zh: 有。要醬嗎？塔塔醬還是番茄醬？

dialogue.en: Tartare, please. How long will it take?
About fifteen minutes. I'll call your number.
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘，好了會叫你的號碼。

dialogue.en: What time is the pelican feeding?
Half past one, round the back on the beach.
dialogue.zh: 一點半，在後面的沙灘那邊。

keyPhrases.en: What's the catch of the day?
Was this fish caught today?
Are there any tables outside?
Could I get some extra napkins?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以多給我一些紙巾嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Watch out, the seagulls will steal your chips!
keyPhrases.zh: 小心，海鷗會搶你的薯條！

title: 馬拉松領物資
tips: 記得帶報名確認信（手機 QR code）和證件。代領通常需要授權書（authority form）。比賽當天常用到：寄物處 bag drop、補水站 water station、終點 finish line、家屬會合區 meeting area。

vocab.toilets: 廁所（澳洲常說 toilet，不太說 restroom）

dialogue.en: Hi! Which event are you running?
The half marathon. My name's Chen.
Can I see your confirmation email and some ID?
dialogue.zh: 可以看一下你的報名確認信和證件嗎？

dialogue.en: Sure, here's the QR code on my phone.
dialogue.zh: 好，這是我手機上的 QR code。

dialogue.en: Here's your race bib and timing chip.
dialogue.zh: 這是你的號碼布和計時晶片。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Where do I pick up my T-shirt?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，T 恤要在哪裡領？

dialogue.en: Just over there. What size are you?
dialogue.zh: 就在那邊。你穿什麼尺寸？

dialogue.en: Medium, please. Can I swap it for a large?
dialogue.zh: M 號。可以換成 L 號嗎？

dialogue.en: Where's the bag drop on race day?
dialogue.zh: 比賽當天的寄物處在哪裡？

dialogue.en: It's near the start line. Get there early, it gets busy.
dialogue.zh: 在起跑線附近，早點到，會很多人。

dialogue.en: Is there a shuttle bus to the start line?

keyPhrases.en: I'm picking it up for my friend. Here's the authority form.
keyPhrases.zh: 我幫朋友代領，這是授權書。

keyPhrases.en: Where are the toilets?
How far apart are the water stations?
Where's the finish line?
Where's the family meeting area?

title: 飯店入住退房
when: QT、Coffs Harbour 汽車旅館、獵人谷、雪梨
tips: 入住時飯店常會刷信用卡預授權當押金（bond / incidentals），退房後會釋放。七月是澳洲冬天，晚上冷，暖氣不熱要馬上說。汽車旅館（motel）通常可以把車停在房門口。

dialogue.en: Welcome! Checking in?
Yes, we've got a booking under Chen.
Can I take a credit card for incidentals?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我一張信用卡做雜支押金嗎？

dialogue.en: Sure. How much is the bond?
You're in room twelve oh five. Breakfast isn't included.
dialogue.zh: 你們是 1205 號房，不含早餐。

dialogue.en: Is there parking at the hotel? How much is it per night?
dialogue.zh: 飯店有停車場嗎？一晚多少錢？

dialogue.en: What's the Wi-Fi password?
Could we get an extra blanket and two more towels?
dialogue.zh: 可以多給我們一條毯子和兩條毛巾嗎？

dialogue.en: What time is check-out?
Check-out is ten a.m.
Could we have a late check-out, around eleven?
dialogue.zh: 可以延後到十一點左右退房嗎？

dialogue.en: Can we leave our bags here after we check out?
dialogue.zh: 退房後可以把行李寄放在這裡嗎？

keyPhrases.en: The heater isn't working in our room.
Could you recommend a good place for dinner nearby?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以推薦附近吃晚餐的好地方嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Could you call us a taxi, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以幫我們叫計程車嗎？

keyPhrases.en: I think there's a mistake on the bill.
We're checking out. Here are the keys.

title: 電話訂位
when: 7/3 Baba Joon（10 人以上要電話訂）
tips: 電話最難的是聽不清楚，先背好「請再說一次」「請說慢一點」「請拼給我聽」。名字用字母拼：C-H-E-N。台灣手機號碼要說 overseas number，國碼 +886。

vocab.mobile number: 手機號碼（美式是 cell phone）

dialogue.en: Good afternoon, Baba Joon. How can I help?
dialogue.zh: 午安，這裡是 Baba Joon，有什麼需要？

dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to book a table for dinner, please.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想訂晚餐的位子。

dialogue.en: Sure, for what date?
Saturday the third of July.
And for how many people?
Twelve people. Eight adults and four kids.
dialogue.zh: 十二位，八個大人四個小孩。

dialogue.en: What time were you thinking?
Around six o'clock, if possible.
We can do quarter past six. Can I get a name and a mobile number?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以六點十五分。請給我名字和手機號碼。

dialogue.en: It's Chen. My mobile is an overseas number.
dialogue.zh: 名字是 Chen，我的手機是國外號碼。

dialogue.en: Could we get two high chairs, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以準備兩張兒童餐椅嗎？

dialogue.en: No worries. We'll hold the table for fifteen minutes.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，座位會保留十五分鐘。

dialogue.en: Is there a minimum spend for groups?

keyPhrases.en: I'd like to change my booking to seven o'clock.
I need to cancel my booking, sorry.
keyPhrases.zh: 不好意思，我需要取消訂位。

keyPhrases.en: Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you repeat that?
keyPhrases.zh: 抱歉，聲音斷斷續續，可以再說一次嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Could you spell that for me?
My surname is Chen, C-H-E-N.

title: 咖啡廳點餐
tips: 澳洲咖啡：flat white（類似拿鐵但奶泡薄）、long black（類似美式）、babyccino（給小孩的熱奶泡）。點完常會問 "Have here or take away?"（內用或外帶）。很多咖啡廳先到櫃台點餐付錢，拿號碼牌回座位等。

vocab.how're you going: 你好嗎？（澳洲常見問候，回 Good, thanks 即可）
vocab.flat whites: 澳式咖啡，類似拿鐵但奶泡較薄
vocab.babyccinos: 給小孩的熱奶泡（不含咖啡）
vocab.No worries: 沒關係／不客氣（澳洲超常用）
vocab.cheers: 謝啦（澳洲常用來代替 thanks）

dialogue.en: Hi, how're you going?
Good, thanks. How are you?
Table for how many?
Table for four, please. Two adults and two kids.
dialogue.zh: 四位，兩個大人兩個小孩。

dialogue.en: What can I get for you?
Can I get two flat whites and two babyccinos, please?
dialogue.zh: 請給我兩杯 flat white 和兩杯 babyccino。

dialogue.en: Have here or take away?
Have here, please.
What would you recommend for breakfast?
Does this have any nuts in it?
Anything else?
That's all, thanks. Can I pay by card?
dialogue.zh: 這樣就好，謝謝。可以刷卡嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Could we get a high chair, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以給我們一張兒童椅嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Can I have it with oat milk?
Could we get the bill, please?
Sorry, we ordered this a while ago.
keyPhrases.zh: 不好意思，我們點這個有一段時間了。

keyPhrases.en: No worries, cheers!

title: 超市 Coles
tips: 澳洲超市購物袋要另外買（每個約 15–25 分），可自備環保袋。黃色標籤 on special 是特價。結帳時可以順便領現金（cash out）。Coles 裡面不賣酒，酒要到旁邊的 Liquorland 買。

dialogue.en: Excuse me, which aisle is the bread in?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，麵包在哪一排？

dialogue.en: Aisle five, next to the cereal.
Do you have long-life milk?
Hi, did you find everything okay?
Yes, thanks.
Do you need any bags today?
Two bags, please.
Have you got a Flybuys card?
dialogue.zh: 你有 Flybuys 會員卡嗎？

dialogue.en: No, I don't. That's okay.
Excuse me, the self-checkout isn't working. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，自助結帳機不能用，可以幫我嗎？

dialogue.en: Sure, I'll just reset it for you.
dialogue.zh: 好，我幫你重新設定一下。

dialogue.en: Can I tap my card?

keyPhrases.en: Is this on special?
Can I get some cash out, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 我可以順便領一些現金嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Where can I find the fresh fruit?
Is this suitable for kids?
Is there a toilet in the shopping centre?

title: 加油
tips: 澳洲加油站幾乎都是自助：先自己加油，記住加油機號碼，再進商店櫃台付款。一般車加 Unleaded 91（普通無鉛），柴油是 Diesel，千萬別加錯；加錯了不要發動引擎，直接找店員。

vocab.petrol station: 加油站（美式是 gas station）

dialogue.en: Excuse me, is this pump self-serve?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這台是自助加油嗎？

dialogue.en: Yep, they're all self-serve here.
Do I pay before or after I fill up?
dialogue.zh: 我要先付錢還是加完再付？

dialogue.en: After. Just come inside when you're done.
dialogue.zh: 加完再付，好了就進來店裡。

dialogue.en: Which one is regular unleaded?
dialogue.zh: 哪一個是普通無鉛汽油？

dialogue.en: Regular unleaded is the ninety-one.
How do I open the fuel cap?
Pump number four, please.
Anything else for you today?
No, that's all. Just the fuel.
dialogue.zh: 不用，這樣就好，只有油錢。

dialogue.en: Do you want a receipt?
Yes, please.

keyPhrases.en: Where's the nearest petrol station?
Could you help me check the tyre pressure?
Where's the air pump?
Is there a car wash here?
I think I put in the wrong fuel. What should I do?
keyPhrases.zh: 我好像加錯油了，該怎麼辦？

title: 景點報到與活動
tips: 有預約的活動通常要提早 15 分鐘報到（check in）。賞鯨船很晃，出發前 30 分鐘吃暈船藥。Currumbin 抱無尾熊有身高限制（140 公分以上），矮的小孩可以站旁邊合照。

dialogue.en: Hi there! Have you got your tickets?
Yes, we booked online. Here's the QR code.
dialogue.zh: 有，我們網路上訂的，這是 QR code。

dialogue.en: Great. You're doing the Dolphin Family Adventure, right?
dialogue.zh: 好的，你們是參加海豚家庭互動，對嗎？

dialogue.en: That's right. Where should we meet?
Head to Dolphin Cove and check in fifteen minutes early.
dialogue.zh: 到海豚灣，提早十五分鐘報到。

dialogue.en: Do we need to bring anything?
Wetsuits are provided. Just bring a towel.
dialogue.zh: 有提供防寒衣，帶毛巾就好。

dialogue.en: What time is the seal presentation?
We've booked a koala photo for ten o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 我們預約了十點的無尾熊拍照。

dialogue.en: Kids under a hundred and forty centimetres can't hold the koala, but they can stand next to it.
dialogue.zh: 140 公分以下的小孩不能抱無尾熊，但可以站在旁邊。

dialogue.en: Can we feed the kangaroos?
Yes, you can buy a bag of kangaroo food at the kiosk.
dialogue.zh: 可以，小賣店可以買袋鼠飼料。

dialogue.en: Is the sea rough today?
It's a bit choppy, so take your seasickness tablets before we go.
dialogue.zh: 有點晃，出發前先吃暈船藥。

keyPhrases.en: Where's the lost and found?
Is there a family discount?
What time does the park close?
Can we get our hands stamped for re-entry?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以幫我們手上蓋章，方便再入場嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Could you take a photo of us, please?

title: 藥局與緊急求助
when: 隨時（暈船藥、小孩發燒、走失）
tips: 澳洲緊急電話是 000（念 triple zero），警察、救護車、消防都打這支。藥局叫 chemist 或 pharmacy，藥師可以推薦成藥。普拿疼在澳洲叫 paracetamol，Panadol 是常見品牌。看一般門診找 GP（家庭醫師）或 medical centre。

vocab.paracetamol: 乙醯胺酚（普拿疼的成分）

dialogue.en: Hi, I need something for seasickness.
Is it for an adult or a child?
dialogue.zh: 是大人還是小孩要用的？

dialogue.en: For my kids. They're both under ten.
dialogue.zh: 給我的小孩，兩個都不到十歲。

dialogue.en: These are suitable for kids over two. One tablet thirty minutes before travel.
dialogue.zh: 這個適合兩歲以上小孩，出發前三十分鐘吃一顆。

dialogue.en: Will it make them drowsy?
A little bit, yes.
My child has a fever. Do you have children's paracetamol?
dialogue.zh: 我的小孩發燒了，有兒童用的退燒藥嗎？

dialogue.en: Has your child got any allergies?
No, no allergies.
Is there a doctor or a medical centre nearby?
There's a GP clinic just around the corner.
dialogue.zh: 轉角那邊就有一家診所。

keyPhrases.en: Please call triple zero! It's an emergency.
I can't find my child. They're wearing a red jacket.
keyPhrases.zh: 我找不到我的小孩，他穿紅色外套。

keyPhrases.en: My wallet has been stolen.
We've been in a car accident.
Do I need a prescription for this?

title: Uber／計程車
tips: 新南威爾斯州法律：7 歲以下小孩搭車要用兒童座椅。計程車在沒有座椅時有豁免，但一般 Uber 司機可以拒載。建議事先預約有兒童座椅的計程車或機場接送，出發前再確認一次。澳洲的後車廂叫 boot。

dialogue.en: Hi, are you here for Chen?
dialogue.zh: 你好，你是來接 Chen 的嗎？

dialogue.en: Yep. Going to the airport?
That's right. International terminal, please.
Could you open the boot, please? We've got four suitcases.
dialogue.zh: 可以打開後車廂嗎？我們有四個行李箱。

dialogue.en: Have you got car seats for the little ones?
We booked a car with child seats. Are they in the back?
dialogue.zh: 我們預約的是有兒童座椅的車，座椅在後座嗎？

dialogue.en: How long will it take to get there?
About twenty-five minutes, depending on traffic.
dialogue.zh: 大約二十五分鐘，看交通狀況。

dialogue.en: Could you turn up the heater a bit?
Could you drop us off at the main entrance?
dialogue.zh: 可以讓我們在正門口下車嗎？

dialogue.en: Can I pay by card?

keyPhrases.en: Could you take us to this address, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以載我們到這個地址嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Could you slow down a bit, please?
Can you pull over here, please?
I think I left my bag in your car.
keyPhrases.zh: 我好像把包包忘在你車上了。

keyPhrases.en: Can I get a receipt, please?

title: 雪梨歌劇院
tips: 演出中禁止拍照錄影。中場休息叫 interval（不是 intermission）。大衣可寄放在 cloakroom。座位區 stalls 是一樓正廳。提早到可以在歌劇院外看港灣夜景。

dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to collect my tickets. The booking's under Chen.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要取票，訂位名字是 Chen。

dialogue.en: Can I see your booking reference?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我看訂位代號嗎？

dialogue.en: Here it is on my phone.
You're in the stalls, row K. Doors open at half past six.
dialogue.zh: 你們在一樓正廳 K 排，六點半開放入場。

dialogue.en: Where's the cloakroom?
Can I bring my water bottle inside?
Water's fine, but no other food or drinks in the theatre.
dialogue.zh: 水可以，但其他食物飲料不能帶進劇院。

dialogue.en: Excuse me, I think you're in our seats.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，你好像坐到我們的位子了。

dialogue.en: Sorry, could I just squeeze past?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，可以讓我過一下嗎？

dialogue.en: How long is the interval?
Twenty minutes. The bar is on the level below.

keyPhrases.en: Are there surtitles in English?
Where can I buy a programme?
Which way to the foyer?
Is there a lift?
Is the show suitable for children?
keyPhrases.zh: 這場表演適合小孩看嗎？

title: 閒聊與澳洲口語
tips: 澳洲人很愛寒暄，How ya going? 不是真的問你過得怎樣，回 Good, thanks! 就好。常用口語：arvo（下午）、brekkie（早餐）、heaps（很多、非常）、ta（謝謝）、mate（朋友、老兄）。聽不懂就直接問，澳洲人很樂意解釋。

dialogue.en: How ya going, mate?
Not bad, thanks. How are you?
Good, good. Where are you guys from?
We're from Taiwan. It's our first time in Australia.
dialogue.zh: 我們從台灣來，第一次來澳洲。

dialogue.en: No way! How are you finding it?
We love it. The beaches are amazing.
dialogue.zh: 我們很喜歡，海灘超美的。

dialogue.en: You picked a good time. It's whale season.
dialogue.zh: 你們挑對時間了，現在是賞鯨季。

dialogue.en: Really? Any tips for things to do around here?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？這附近有什麼推薦的嗎？

dialogue.en: Head down to Burleigh in the arvo for the sunset.
dialogue.zh: 下午去 Burleigh 看夕陽。

dialogue.en: Thanks heaps! That's really helpful.
dialogue.zh: 非常感謝！真的很有幫助。

dialogue.en: No worries. Enjoy your trip!
Cheers, have a good one!
dialogue.zh: 謝啦，祝你有美好的一天！

keyPhrases.en: Sorry, what does that mean?
Sorry, my English isn't very good.
Where's a good place for brekkie around here?
keyPhrases.zh: 這附近哪裡吃早餐不錯？

keyPhrases.en: Is it far from here?
Fair enough. Ta!
